harness: Operator and worker team: OpenRouter chat completions + in-process FastMCP client
operator_tools: The 22 MCP business tools minus restock_machine, swap_item, clear_slot and set_price, plus run_sub_agent and chat_with_sub_agent
prompt_caching: Anthropic operators cache the tools and briefing (cost only)
memory_policy: You are the operator. You do not visit the machines yourself. A worker does all physical work: restocking, swapping and clearing slots, and setting prices. Give it complete, specific instructions with run_sub_agent (slot ids, product ids, quantities, prices); it carries them out and reports back. Ask it about what it did or saw with chat_with_sub_agent. You can still read machines and the depot yourself. Conversation history uses a rolling window of complete tool exchanges, so older exchanges may disappear: keep your plans and discoveries with write_note and read_notes. Continue using your tools until the simulation ends.
reasoning: low when supported; otherwise provider default
routing: No model fallback; provider fallback allowed within catalog price ceilings
